segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report the cleanser controls oil, helps with clogged pores and t-zone breakouts, without over-drying, though one oily-skin reviewer felt it made her skin more oily than a cheaper cleanser.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin generally say it cleans without leaving skin tight, dry or flaky, and some use it specifically on dry or dull days, though one reviewer with dry/oily skin still felt slightly dry afterward and recommends a moisturizer.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers (oily T-zone, drier cheeks) mostly report soft, refreshed, non-tight skin and fewer t-zone breakouts, but one combination-skin reviewer says the product does nothing for her.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers overwhelmingly describe it as gentle, non-irritating and non-drying, with reduced redness and breakouts, but one self-described non-sensitive reviewer had cystic pimples, red bumps and swollen, flaky eyelids.
segments.mature: Mature-skin reviewers (40s-60s) report brighter, more even-toned skin, reduced dark/age spots and improved texture over months to years of use.

concerns.aging: Reviewers using it for aging skin report reduced age spots, sun damage and hyperpigmentation, brighter tone and smaller-looking pores after weeks to months of use; no dissent noted specifically tied to aging concerns.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say the cleanser does not dry out skin and leaves it hydrated or soft even with twice-daily use, but a few report it leaves skin slightly dry or that they still need a moisturizer right after.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers report reduced redness, including one with rosacea and one with sensitive skin who saw redness nearly disappear after two days; no negative reports on redness were found.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers describe the cleanser as gentle enough for daily double use without stripping or tight feelings, and one with seasonal flakiness/itching reported the itching stopped; one reviewer's eyelids became red, swollen and flaky.
concerns.spots: Reviewers report lightening of dark spots, hyperpigmentation, sun damage marks and age spots over one to several weeks, though one reviewer using only the travel size saw no brightening effect on dark spots.
concerns.blemishes: Many reviewers with acne-prone or breakout-prone skin report clearer skin, fewer cystic or hormonal breakouts, and faster healing of blemishes over weeks to years; however a few report new breakouts, including cystic spots, or no improvement at all.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers report the cleanser balances oil and reduces clogged pores without over-drying, though one reviewer says her skin became more oily using this than with a cheaper alternative.

aspects.libelle: Reduced bottle size at same price

extraits.texte: This was just not for me I guess. I've liked many other Murad products before but this was a miss. I do NOT have sensitive skin at all and it's few and far between that a product irritates my skin, but this cleanser did. I never really break out, and with this product I did...a few cystic spots and then a bunch of tiny red bumps. Also even worse was that my eye lids became red, swollen, and flakey. I know cleansers say "stay away from eyes" but I have used many cleansers over the years as a professional makeup artist and esthetician and always used my Dermalogica, Skinceuticals, Revive, and many other cleansers over my lids and been just fine. So I guess my suggestion is definitly dont use this by the eye area!
I originally got this in an Ipsy bag. I use it in the morning. I have sensitive skin. It's dry/combination skin and it gets more oily in the summer.

Never saw dramatic results from a face cleanser before I tried this, I've been using this every morning for about 6 months now and my skin has never stayed so pimple free. The travel size lasts me a little over 2 months. It does not foam up but after I rinse my skin feels deeply hydrated and clean. This keeps my acne prone skin clear and glowy...I will never go without it! I love when I see results from my skin care products and this does not disappoint at all

extraits.titre: This is all I will wash with.
extraits.texte: I've been using this face wash over a year now. Any time I have thought about cutting costs and trying something cheaper I end up a broken out mess, I switch back and boom clean again. Even now while I'm pregnant it's the only thing keeping me clear. I use this entire line. I'm dry/oily and in high school I was on acutane due to severe acne so I go from super dry to super oily in a flash. I don't wear face make up and this line keeps my skin feeling light and fresh all day! Even through workouts.

This cleanser is so amazing. I have sensitive, dry skin with rosacea on my lower cheeks and was afraid to try this, but it has worked so well to BRIGHTEN my skin. My pores have shrunk around my nose and chin. It has actually lessened the redness of my cheeks. So happy with this product!!!

I suffer from combination skin that tends to self destruct whenever the seasons change. During spring and summer, my skin is horrible to deal with. I have weird flakiness and a terrible itching no matter what moisturizer I use. I gave this cleanser a shot and I'm so glad I did. I wash my face every morning with this cleanser and I notice NO itchiness throughout the day. I haven't changed my routine other than using this cleanser and I can say I have seen a difference. My skin also doesn't look as dull nor flaky. I am so relieved to have found a cleanser to keep my skin happy even against environmental factors.

I truly don't know why this cleanser has such good reviews. As a future Esthetician, I have tried many good skincare products and this is by far the worst in the sense that it does absolutely nothing for me. I have combination skin which means I have an oily T-zone and normal-dry on my cheeks and such. This cleanser does nothing and I expected something, especially at this price point!
